name: tflint-linter
description: TFLint integration for Visual Studio Code

tflint.runOnSave.description: Run tflint automatically on file save.

tflint.runOnOpen.description: Run tflint automatically when a file is opened.

tflint.chdir.description: Run tflint with --chdir set to the directory containing the file (lints the whole module).

tflint.configFile.description: Path to the TFLint configuration file. Relative paths resolve from the containing workspace folder. When empty, the nearest ancestor .tflint.hcl within the workspace is used.

tflint.runOnType.description: Run tflint as you type (debounced). Requires tflint to be fast in your setup.

tflint.typeDebounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before running tflint (used when tflint.runOnType is enabled).

tflint.excludeRules.description: List of tflint rule names to disable (passed as --disable-rule=<name>).
